# Pawn selector previews

The following preview thumbnails were generated for the Trilha Redes lobby with the built-in image generation tool on 2026-10-29:

- `pawn-cyan-preview.png`
- `pawn-magenta-preview.png`
- `pawn-gold-preview.png`

Prompt pattern: polished isometric 3D cyberpunk board-game pawn, centered with transparent background and no text, rendered respectively in cyan, magenta, and gold.

These images are selector previews only. The in-game model remains `cyber-pawn.glb`; its attribution is in `ATTRIBUTION.md`.
